reply_text: I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread. The only date I could find is from Marcus's post in that channel on 14 October: the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form is due 21 December. Nothing else in #north-team discusses it, and none of the public files mention it, so I couldn't confirm that date was agreed with anyone. I suggested she check with Marcus before she marks it as settled in the tracker. A deadline date isn't a money term, so it was fine to share in the channel.
